name: Blaster (Artificer Archetype)
body:
A lot of artificers tinker with magical technology to achieve many different aims. Some, however, just want to blast some stuff.

Arcanotech Blaster (Su)

At 1st level, a blaster has created an arcane object that allows you to unleash blasts of pure magic energy. These blasts are considered a ranged touch attack with a maximum range of 30 feet and take a standard action to use. The blast from this weapon deals 1d6 force damage plus the artificer’s Intelligence modifier. The blast deals an additional 1d6 damage at each odd level after 1st. This object cannot be used by other characters and the object’s form is up to the creator. Some look like guns or wands, others like gauntlets. These objects can be disarmed or destroyed normally (hp and hardness = CL), unless they are attached like gauntlets, at which point they can’t be disarmed. If the arcanotech blaster is destroyed or lost, it can be replaced with time and effort costing 1 hour and 100 gp per class level. This ability replaces spells.

Blast Modification (Su)

At 5th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the blaster chooses a modification for their arcanotech blaster from the options below. Unless otherwise specified, a blast modification can only be selected once. Only one shape modification and one effect modification can be added to a single use of your arcanotech blaster. Miscellaneous modifications are constantly active or usable and don’t count toward either shape or effect. Any DC for the blast modification is DC 10 + 1/2 the blaster’s class level + their Intelligence modifier.

Miscellaneous Modifications
Dual Blast: As a full round action, the arcanotech blaster can fire ranged two blasts at the same or different targets, suffering a -2 penalty on each blast and dealing damage as though they were a blaster of 4 levels lower (minimum 1st level).
Increased Range: The range of the arcanotech blaster doubles. This modification may be selected a second time, doubling the total range again.
Melee Blast: As a swift action, the blaster can use their arcanotech blaster as an enhanced melee weapon, dealing blast damage as though the blaster were 8 levels lower (minimum 1st level). This is treated as a normal melee attack against a target’s AC. You gain a bonus on this attack roll equal to the number of normal arcanotech blaster dice you can deal. This effect persists as long as the blaster wishes, but if disarmed or if it otherwise leaves the blaster’s hand, it loses this property. It is considered a one-handed melee weapon, and the blaster is considered proficient in it, and it may be used to make iterative attacks.
Shape Modifications
Arcing Blast: When the blaster deals damage to a single target with their arcanotech blaster, they may choose an additional target within 15 feet of that creature as a secondary target. The secondary target makes a Reflex saving throw or take damage equal to 1/2 the total damage dealt to the original target.
Cone Blast: The blaster can shape their blast into a 15 foot cone which deals damage as though they were a blaster of 4 levels lower (minimum 1) and allows for a Reflex save to reduce the damage by half. This blast modification can be selected a second time to increase the range of the cone to 30 feet and a third time to increase the range to 60 feet.
Explosive Blast: The arcanotech blaster now does splash damage to creatures adjacent to the target equal to its minimum damage. A target of the splash damage may make a Reflex save to halve that damage.
Weapon Type	Bonus
Light	+3 bonus on Disable Device checks
One-Handed	+3 bonus on Use Magic device checks
Two-handed	+3 bonus on concentration checks and checks to bypass spell resistance
Bludgeoning	+2 bonus on Fortitude saves
Piercing	+2 bonus on Reflex saves
Slashing	+3 hit points
Effect Modifications
Frost Blast: The blaster can increase the damage die by one step of their arcanotech blaster and it deals cold damage instead. This blast modification can be taken a second time, granting the blaster a secondary effect when it deals cold damage to a target. A target damaged by the frost blast must make a Reflex save or become entangled for 2d4 rounds.
Penetrating Blast: Any creature struck by the arcanotech blaster has its spell resistance reduced by 5; this stacks up to 3 times and lasts for one round per class level with the duration resetting with each subsequent hit. Shocking Blast: The blaster can increase the damage die by one step of their arcanotech blaster and deal electricity damage. This modification can be taken a second time, granting the blaster a secondary effect when it deals electricity damage to a target. A target damaged by the shocking blast must make a Fortitude save or become staggered for 1d4 rounds. Searing Blast: The blaster can increase the damage die by one step of their arcanotech blaster and it deals fire damage instead. This modification can be taken a second time, allowing the blast to ignore fire resistance and immunity.

This ability replaces retain charge.

Perfected Technology (Su)

The blaster has found more efficient means of powering their arcanotech blaster. They may choose two of the following effects to apply to all of their arcanotech blaster uses, regardless of modification. Increase the size of its damage die by one step, increase its critical threat range and multiplier both by 1, double its base range, or add double the blaster’s Intelligence modifier to the damage.

This ability replaces master artificer.
